slides.title: S01
content: [SCREEN ID=S01 TYPE=STATIC SCENE=SCENE-01 LOCATION=LOC-01] SUR:  Close 3 files this week — you earn your first performance bonus. ₹8,000.  RAV:  Sir, I have one strong lead. Mr. Sharma — grocery shop owner near the railway station. He called last week about a home loan.  SUR:  Good. But before you go — learn what to check. Six things. Miss one and the file comes back.  [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S02
content: [SCREEN ID=S02 TYPE=TAB SCENE=SCENE-01 LOCATION=LOC-01 ASSET_REF=PROP-02] SUR:  Six checkpoints. Learn all six before you walk into that shop.  [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S03
content: [SCREEN ID=S03 TYPE=TAB LOCATION=LOC-01 ASSET_REF=PROP-01] NAR:  Read this before meeting Mr. Sharma. Three rules. Property, income, and ownership. All three must pass.  [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S04
content: [SCREEN ID=S04 TYPE=BRANCHING SCENE=SCENE-02 LOCATION=LOC-03] SHA:  Beta, you called about a home loan? Come, sit down. Have some chai.  RAV:  Thank you Sharma ji. Three quick questions before we discuss anything else.  SHA:  I have already booked a 1BHK flat on the outskirts of town. Still under construction.  [BRANCH_POINT ID=BP04_1] [OPTION LETTER=A SCORE=10 NEXT=PATH_S04_A VO_ID=VO-S04-RAV-02A] What is the total cost as per the builder agreement Sharma ji — including all charges like parking and registration? [/OPTION] [OPTION LETTER=B SCORE=5 NEXT=PATH_S04_B VO_ID=VO-S04-RAV-02B] How much home loan are you looking for, Sharma ji? [/OPTION] [/BRANCH_POINT] [PATH ID=PATH_S04_A] SHA:  Total cost is ₹16 lakhs as per the agreement. That includes parking and registration charges.  [/PATH] [PATH ID=PATH_S04_B] SHA:  I was thinking around ₹12 to 13 lakhs loan. The flat costs ₹16 lakhs total.  RAV:  Understood Sharma ji. And the total cost of the flat as per the builder agreement — what is that figure including all charges?  SHA:  Oh, the total cost — that is ₹16 lakhs. Includes parking and registration as per the builder's agreement.  [/PATH] [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S05
content: [SCREEN ID=S05 TYPE=BRANCHING SCENE=SCENE-04 LOCATION=LOC-04] SHA:  So what else do you need to know beta?  [BRANCH_POINT ID=BP05_1] [OPTION LETTER=A SCORE=10 NEXT=PATH_S05_A VO_ID=VO-S05-RAV-01A] What comes into the household every month from all sources — your shop, your wife, anything else that is regular? [/OPTION] [OPTION LETTER=B SCORE=5 NEXT=PATH_S05_B VO_ID=VO-S05-RAV-01B] What is your monthly income from the shop, Sharma ji? [/OPTION] [/BRANCH_POINT] [PATH ID=PATH_S05_A] SHA:  From the shop around ₹25,000 per month. My wife also does tailoring from home — maybe ₹8,000 to ₹10,000. So together ₹33,000 to ₹35,000.  [/PATH] [PATH ID=PATH_S05_B] SHA:  Around ₹25,000 from the shop beta.  RAV:  And is there any other income in the household Sharma ji — your wife, any rent, anything else that comes in regularly?  SHA:  Yes, my wife does tailoring from home. Maybe ₹8,000 to ₹10,000 per month. I should have mentioned that.  [/PATH] [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S06
content: [SCREEN ID=S06 TYPE=BRANCHING SCENE=SCENE-04 LOCATION=LOC-04] SHA:  Is there anything else you need to know beta?  [BRANCH_POINT ID=BP06_1] [OPTION LETTER=A SCORE=10 NEXT=PATH_S06_A VO_ID=VO-S06-RAV-01A] Just one more thing Sharma ji — have you or your family ever owned a home before, or will this be your first? [/OPTION] [OPTION LETTER=B SCORE=5 NEXT=PATH_S06_B VO_ID=VO-S06-RAV-01B] Sharma ji, you do not own any property currently — right? [/OPTION] [/BRANCH_POINT] [PATH ID=PATH_S06_A] SHA:  First time beta. My father rented, I have rented all my life. This will be the first home our family has ever owned.  [/PATH] [PATH ID=PATH_S06_B] SHA:  No no beta, nothing like that. Why — is that a problem?  RAV:  Not at all Sharma ji — just a standard check I ask everyone. Is this going to be your first home?  SHA:  Yes beta, first time. My father rented, I have rented all my life. This will be our first home. I got a little worried when you asked like that.  [/PATH] [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S07
content: [SCREEN ID=S07 TYPE=STATIC ASSET_REF=PROP-18] SUR:  Eligibility confirmed. Now — is the property actually right for our product?  [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S08
content: [SCREEN ID=S08 TYPE=TAB ASSET_REF=PROP-10] NAR:  Read this before the income conversation. Three rules — household income, FOIR, and informal income. All three matter.  [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S09
content: [SCREEN ID=S09 TYPE=DRAG_DROP LOCATION=LOC-04 ASSET_REF=PROP-11] NAR:  Mr. Sharma mentioned four income figures. Not all of them count for the FOIR calculation. Drag each one to the right zone.  [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S10
content: [SCREEN ID=S10 TYPE=MCQ ASSET_REF=PROP-12] NAR:  Mr. Sharma's household income is ₹33,000. Proposed home loan EMI is ₹11,500. No existing EMIs. FOIR equals 35%. What does this mean for the file?  [BRANCH_POINT ID=BP10_1] [OPTION LETTER=A SCORE=10 NEXT=NEXT_SCREEN VO_ID=VO-S10-NAR-02A] 35% is within the 50% limit. File can proceed. [/OPTION] [OPTION LETTER=B SCORE=5 NEXT=NEXT_SCREEN VO_ID=VO-S10-NAR-02B] 35% is borderline. Ravi should reduce the loan amount to be safe. [/OPTION] [/BRANCH_POINT] [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S11
content: [SCREEN ID=S11 TYPE=BRANCHING SCENE=SCENE-05 LOCATION=LOC-05] MRS:  My husband said you need to ask me about my income beta. I don't have any paperwork — ITR or anything like that.  RAV:  No problem Mrs. Sharma. Let me ask you a couple of things.  MRS:  I do tailoring from home. I have been doing it for 12 years. But everything is cash — no records as such.  [BRANCH_POINT ID=BP11_1] [OPTION LETTER=A SCORE=10 NEXT=PATH_S11_A VO_ID=VO-S11-RAV-02A] That is completely fine Mrs. Sharma. Our product is designed for customers like you. I just need to understand what documents you do have — even if they are not formal tax returns. [/OPTION] [OPTION LETTER=B SCORE=5 NEXT=PATH_S11_B VO_ID=VO-S11-RAV-02B] Mrs. Sharma, can you get an ITR filed before we proceed? It would help the file significantly. [/OPTION] [/BRANCH_POINT] [PATH ID=PATH_S11_A] MRS:  Oh good beta. I was worried. I do have an order book where I write every customer's work. And I have a bank account — though mostly I withdraw cash. And a post office RD I have been paying for 4 years.  [/PATH] [PATH ID=PATH_S11_B] MRS:  Filing ITR will take so much time beta. But I do have an order book, a bank account, and a post office RD I have been paying for 4 years. Is that helpful?  [/PATH] [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S12
content: [SCREEN ID=S12 TYPE=BRANCHING SCENE=SCENE-05 LOCATION=LOC-05] RAV:  That is very helpful Mrs. Sharma. Let me confirm what I need to collect from you.  [BRANCH_POINT ID=BP12_1] [OPTION LETTER=A SCORE=10 NEXT=PATH_S12_A VO_ID=VO-S12-RAV-02A] The order book, bank statement, and RD passbook together are exactly what we need. Can I also get the electricity bill for this address in your name? [/OPTION] [OPTION LETTER=B SCORE=5 NEXT=PATH_S12_B VO_ID=VO-S12-RAV-02B] Please give me the order book and bank statement. That should be enough. [/OPTION] [/BRANCH_POINT] [PATH ID=PATH_S12_A] MRS:  Yes beta, I can get all of that ready. Give me one day.  [/PATH] [PATH ID=PATH_S12_B] MRS:  Yes beta, I can give you those. Should I also get the electricity bill and my RD passbook?  [/PATH] RAV:  Perfect. Your income is just as important as Sharma ji's for this file, Mrs. Sharma.  MRS:  Thank you beta. Nobody told us that before.  [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S13
content: [SCREEN ID=S13 TYPE=STATIC ASSET_REF=PROP-18] SUR:  Income picture sorted. Now collect the documents — and check every single paper before you leave that shop.  [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S14

slides.title: S15
content: [SCREEN ID=S15 TYPE=HOTSPOT LOCATION=LOC-04 ASSET_REF=PROP-14] NAR:  Ravi goes through each document carefully. Click all four to examine them — then answer.  [BRANCH_POINT ID=BP15_1] [OPTION LETTER=A SCORE=10 NEXT=NEXT_SCREEN VO_ID=VO-S15-NAR-06A] The name on PAN (R.K. Sharma) and Aadhaar (Ramesh Kumar Sharma) do not match. This must be corrected before submission. [/OPTION] [OPTION LETTER=B SCORE=5 NEXT=NEXT_SCREEN VO_ID=VO-S15-NAR-06B] The electricity bill is not required since Aadhaar address matches. It should be removed from the file. [/OPTION] [/BRANCH_POINT] RAV:  Sharma ji, PAN shows R.K. Sharma but Aadhaar shows your full name. Please update PAN through your CA — about 7 to 10 days.  SHA:  I will go today itself beta.  [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S16
content: [SCREEN ID=S16 TYPE=DRAG_DROP LOCATION=LOC-04 ASSET_REF=PROP-15] SHA:  Here are the property papers beta — booking receipt, allotment letter, and the NOC the builder gave me last week.  NAR:  Ravi examines each document. Sort them into the correct zone.  RAV:  Sharma ji — please collect a signed stamped allotment letter from the builder's office. And ask them to reissue the NOC addressed to XYZ HFC.  SHA:  I will go to the builder's office tomorrow morning.  [/SCREEN]

slides.title: S17
content: [SCREEN ID=S17 TYPE=BRANCHING LOCATION=LOC-02] SHA:  Beta, my younger brother Vikram wants to join as co-applicant. He earns ₹20,000 from his job — it will only strengthen the file, right?  RAV:  Sharma ji, does Vikram ji currently own any residential property?  SHA:  Yes — he bought a small flat in Pune 2 years ago. He lives there.  [BRANCH_POINT ID=BP17_1] [OPTION LETTER=A SCORE=10 NEXT=PATH_S17_A VO_ID=VO-S17-RAV-02A] Sharma ji, Vikram ji owns a flat in Pune — under our AHFC product, co-applicants must also be first-time buyers. He cannot be included. But do not worry — I have already checked the FOIR on your and Mrs. Sharma's income alone and the file is perfectly strong. [/OPTION] [OPTION LETTER=B SCORE=5 NEXT=PATH_S17_B VO_ID=VO-S17-RAV-02B] Sharma ji, let me check with my manager and come back to you on whether Vikram ji can join. [/OPTION] [/BRANCH_POINT] [PATH ID=PATH_S17_A] SHA:  Oh. But the file is still okay without him beta?  RAV:  Absolutely Sharma ji. FOIR is 35% on your and Mrs. Sharma's income. The file is strong — Vikram ji's income was a bonus but you do not need it.  SHA:  Thank you for explaining beta. You handled that well.  [/PATH] [PATH ID=PATH_S17_B] SUR:  Ravi, you did not need to escalate this. The policy is clear — co-applicant owns property, they cannot join an AHFC file. Call Sharma ji back and tell him.  RAV:  Understood sir. I will call him now.  [/PATH] [/SCREEN]
